subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should this PR establish lifecycle-owned prepared model snapshots as the permanent shared runtime contract, including the public deprecated `loadModelCatalog` compatibility wrapper?
rationale: This changes a broad shared ownership boundary and a released plugin SDK surface; source-level comparison and maintainer intent are required before accepting the permanent contract.

options.title: Review and land the lifecycle contract
options.body: Confirm the snapshot publication, stale-owner, reload, and SDK compatibility semantics, then merge with the supplied focused proof plus exact-head validation.

options.title: Narrow the public compatibility surface
options.body: Keep the internal lifecycle refactor but revise the plugin SDK wrapper or exports before merge if maintainers do not want these new public reader APIs.

options.title: Split the refactor
options.body: Separate the SDK contract decision from the internal ownership migration if the lifecycle work is acceptable but the public API direction is not.

recommendation.title: Review and land the lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the snapshot publication, stale-owner, reload, and SDK compatibility semantics, then merge with the supplied focused proof plus exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR identifies zeroaltitude as the source of the original sponsored performance direction, making them the strongest available routing candidate from the supplied evidence.
